meta.name: market-entry
meta.description: Decides whether and how to enter a new market — sizing demand from the bottom up rather than from a market report, testing whether your advantage transfers, choosing between organic entry, partnership and acquisition, sequencing the operational and regulatory work that entry actually requires, and setting the criteria that would tell you to stop. Use this to evaluate a new geography, segment or vertical, pressure-test an entry plan, or work out why a launched market never reached scale.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 判断该不该进新市场,并规划进入路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正打算进入新地区或新行业,想先验证机会再投入。
copy.tagline_en: Assess a new market opportunity and plan your entry strategy.

howto.what: 会从可统计的单位自下而上估算市场需求，检验你的优势在新市场能否转移，比较自主进入、合作与收购三种方式，并梳理运营、法规清单和停止条件。
howto.when: 当你评估新地域、细分或行业是否进入，或想检验已有进入计划、复盘已推出但未做大的市场时触发。

say.text: 帮我从下往上估算东南亚市场的真实需求。
say.note: 会列出可数单位并推演规模。

say.text: 我们的品牌口碑在日本能直接复制吗？
say.note: 检验优势是否真能转移。

say.text: 列出进入德国前要做的法规和运营事项。

howto.what_en: Builds a bottom-up market demand estimate from countable units, checks whether your advantage transfers, compares organic entry, partnership and acquisition, lists operational and regulatory tasks, and sets stop criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you evaluate a new geography, segment or vertical, want to pressure-test an entry plan, or diagnose why a launched market never scaled.

say_en.text: Help me estimate real demand in Southeast Asia from the bottom up.
Does our brand reputation transfer directly to Japan?
List the regulatory and operational tasks before entering Germany.
say_en.note: It produces a checklist and order.
